senses.gloss: ग॑मध्यै (dat. inf.) to go or come.
गमनीय a. accessible, attainable, assailable by (gen.)
गमागम m. going and coming, going to and fro.
*गमिन् a. intending to go to (acc. or —˚).

ग॑मिष्ठ (superl.) coming willingly, ready to enter
(—˚).
गमिष्णु॑ a. going or willing to go.

गम्य a. to be approached or entered, accessible (also for
sex. intercourse), attainable to (gen., loc., or —˚), possible, fit,
proper;
 to be guessed or understood^1, perceptible, intelligible. Abstr.
˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
गाम्भीर्य n. depth, profundity, dignity, generosity.
